description: This file defines macros for memory section placement using compiler-specific attributes or pragmas, supporting different compilers. It is used for mapping memory areas to specific sections in an AUTOSAR context, with support for section attributes like RAM logging, cache, and initialization policies.

methods.name: SECTION_RAMLOG
methods.description: Macro for placing variables in RAM log section, varies by compiler
